purpose: Track evidence-based capability comparisons without implying equivalence between cloud posture and IaC scanners.

upstream_tools.name: Prowler
upstream_tools.primary_comparison: AWS cloud security posture checks and native finding ingestion

upstream_tools.name: Checkov
upstream_tools.primary_comparison: Terraform/IaC policy checks, variable handling and module analysis

upstream_tools.name: Trivy
upstream_tools.primary_comparison: IaC misconfiguration and broader security scanning workflows

upstream_tools.name: ScoutSuite
upstream_tools.primary_comparison: Multi-service cloud posture inventory and findings

upstream_tools.name: Cloudsplaining
upstream_tools.primary_comparison: IAM policy risk analysis and privilege exposure

upstream_tools.name: Parliament
upstream_tools.primary_comparison: IAM policy syntax and security linting

priority_gaps.acceptance: Values resolve only when statically provable; unresolved values are explicit.
Deterministic edges, canonical addresses and no false safe conclusions for unknowns.
Summary and exit status distinguish incomplete analysis from a clean result.
Policy semantics are tested against upstream references; conditions are not treated as proof of safety.
Reachability claims require a documented graph path and confidence; simple co-occurrence is not an attack path.
Prioritise identity, network exposure, data protection, audit logging, backup/recovery, containers and serverless.

mapping_policy.rule: Do not mark a check equivalent based only on similar names; compare semantics, evidence requirements, defaults, exceptions and unknown-state handling.
